name: house_v1
doc: A village house, store, or workshop, outside only (design/systems.md, Village houses): the game asks for a type, a stage of its owner's upgrades (construction, basic, deluxe, premium), a season, and a footprint, with the local wind; build makes the building on its lot with its sign, yard, and moving parts, and the animator sways, spins, smokes, flickers, and opens the door when the game says.

params.name: type
params.doc: A type: one entry from config/house_v1_types/.

params.name: stage
params.doc: How far its owner has come. Every stage stands on the same footprint.

params.name: footprint
params.doc: The type's usual footprint or its other one.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Which of the distinct buildings per type, stage, and season (the runtime caps how many by quality).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.

params.name: door_time
params.doc: Seconds since the door opened; negative while it is shut. The game starts it when someone comes to the door (foundry_house_v1_start_door); it opens, stays for a visit, and closes.
